blocks.text: The Tribal Communities Association of the Philippines, Inc. (TRICAP) marked National Indigenous Peoples Month 2026 with an extensive series of nationwide activities in support of the National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP), bringing together Indigenous leaders, government institutions, academic partners, civil society organizations, development partners, and grassroots communities in advancing Indigenous Peoples’ rights, cultural preservation, and empowerment. Anchored on the theme, “Empowering Indigenous Peoples: Strengthening Rights, Culture and Ancestral Domains,” TRICAP’s month-long engagements reflected its continuing commitment to ensuring that Indigenous Peoples (IPs) are not merely beneficiaries of development programs but active participants in policymaking, governance, education, and nation-building.
